objective: Improve independent verification coverage for a local research-claim pipeline without weakening provenance controls.

scope.evaluation_horizon: One isolated test run and a 20-step simulator comparison

provenance_integrity.rationale: The local provenance test passes with complete identifiers.

trust_quorum.rationale: The available audit bounds but does not identify reviewer independence.

causal_formation.rationale: No comparison supports a causal estimate.

dimensional_consistency.rationale: All checked interfaces use consistent units and types.

exact_self_maintenance.rationale: Maintenance over the declared horizon was not measured.

finite_horizon_resource_persistence.rationale: The budget supplies a conservative finite-horizon interval.

target_bound_generative_catalysis.rationale: Certified inflow is counted against the declared target.

verification_capacity.rationale: Coverage is measured and is currently the binding observation.

effective_independence.rationale: Observed failure correlation yields an interval.

coordination_protocol_integrity.rationale: Recovery and routing invariants pass locally.

perturbation_robustness.rationale: The finite perturbation suite supports only an interval.

phase_readiness.rationale: The bottleneck-sensitive readiness is below threshold.

capability_reproduction.rationale: Modeled certified inflow exceeds modeled loss.

residual_ratio.criterion: Residual debt ratio must not exceed the scenario threshold.
residual_ratio.rationale: No reconciled residual ledger was supplied.

resource_floor.criterion: Resources must remain above the declared floor for the hold period.
resource_floor.rationale: The resource interval crosses the threshold.

critical_unknowns.rationale: Residual debt is a critical unknown.

hold_period.criterion: All gates must hold for 20 consecutive steps.
hold_period.rationale: The intervention has not yet been run.

unknowns.description: Residual debt has not been reconciled against current capital.

interventions.title: Add an independently sampled verification path
interventions.mechanism: Exercise a second verifier path and preserve separate evidence receipts.

cost.uncertainty: Illustrative estimate; measure before operational use.

interventions.expected_effect: Increase measured verification coverage without counting correlated checks twice.
non_claims: The intervention does not establish external evidence truth.
The intervention does not certify ASI.

actions: Compare baseline and intervention with matched resources.

rollback.trigger: Coverage fails to improve or residual debt increases.

unresolved: Long-horizon resource persistence is not observed.

non_claims: It does not predict or certify real ASI.
It does not prove a scientific phase transition or real-world causal effect.
